page.layout: One printed page. A single wide text column of Latin with Arabic and Greek inline and a short Arabic verse; in the right margin, beside the lower part of the column, one note in Latin and Arabic; below the column, a catchword at the right.

main_text.p: vellet eligeret, juxta hęc vero nulla præcess[?] ceptio videatur, كاذوا أغا ارا ان يم سروا اشتروا اجزوا ذسيهة وذكروة قبل ارن يدبروا وقسوة ثمانيه ة وعشرين قسما ان عشرة اقسام فاذا خرج واحد واحد باسم رجل رجل ظهر فوز من خرج لهم ذوات الانصبا وغرم من خرج له الغفل Solebant quoties sortiri vellent, camelí pullum, pretio facto, jugulatum antequam sortiren-tur, in partes viginti octo, vel denas dissertiri, cúmque singulis nominatim educerentur, viētores haberi quibus prodirent sortes portionibus adscriptis, victi autem quibus prodirent ἀσπιδες; deinde quod ad الغفل seu sortium πῶς ἀσπιδες tum numerum, tum usum, quæ Al-Zamachshario, & AlSharizio, tres tantum sunt, scil. ١ المنيح ٢ السفيج ٣ الوعن quas & hoc versu complexus est Poëta

لي في الدنيا سهام ليس فيهن ربيح واسمايهن وغن و سفيح ومنيحا Mibi in mundo sortes sunt, quibus nullum est lucrum, quarum nomina sunt Wagdo, & Safiho, & Maniho, nulla facta mentione, nam المصدر AlMosaddar, eadem esse potest cum afferente alibi AlFirauzabadio, AlMosaddar esse الفداح او ل Sagittarum ἀσπιδων primam; quæ & ex horum sententia, non inutiles tantum fortienti, sed & maximè damnosæ; siquidem testibus AlZamachshario &Citant 'AlZa-machsh. &' جامع اللغة

page.notes: Printed text is partly unreadable at the scan resolution. Doubtful: "præcess[?] ceptio" (the printed form looks garbled, possibly a misprint for præceptio). The Arabic lines of the first verse block and the inline Arabic words (e.g. "كاذوا أغا ارا ان يم سروا اشتروا اجزوا", "ذسيهة وذكروة", "ثمانيه ة") are copied as best as the scan allows and may contain errors; the Greek words after "ἀσπιδες" and "seu sortium" are uncertain. The line "ἀσπιδων primam" may read differently. The "Google" watermark in the lower right corner was left out.
